findings.summary: The packet-owned validator duplicates the established shared route-segment predicate with a fixed maximum length.
findings.consequence: Future changes to the route-segment safety policy can drift between author document routing and other managed route boundaries that already use the shared validator.
findings.evidence: `validManagedSegment` repeats the same non-empty, max-length, trim, dot-segment, slash, percent, control-character, and lone-surrogate checks implemented by `shared/utils/route-segment.ts` `validRouteSegment`; direct callers only need the same policy with maximum length 100.
findings.recommendation: Import `validRouteSegment` from `shared/utils/route-segment.ts` and implement this function as `typeof value === "string" && validRouteSegment(value, 100)`, or delete this wrapper if callers can use the shared predicate directly.
